breakdown.description: With R ∝ 1/α, increasing α lowers thermal-shock resistance rather than improving it.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the logical error in the original prompt. It explicitly states that since the thermal expansion coefficient (α) is in the denominator of the equation for the thermal-shock parameter (R), increasing α will *decrease* R, thus worsening (not improving) the thermal-shock resistance. This directly resolves the stated inconsistency.
